review.assessment: The change introduces a `chunk` function that fails to include elements forming a partial group at the end of the array, violating the requirement to place every element into a chunk. The implementation only appends subarrays when they reach the exact size limit, resulting in data loss for arrays whose length is not a multiple of `size`. This defect explains why acceptance tests might pass if they lack coverage for non-divisible input lengths.

findings.defect: Drops partial chunks at end of array
